description: Personal skills, subagents and hooks (context handoff): Go API design and performance, testing, specs, architecture review, technical writing.

handoff_offer_at.title: Handoff: offer at (% of auto-compact)
handoff_offer_at.description: Show the handoff offer when context reaches this percent of the auto-compact threshold (the model's window when auto-compact is off). 0 turns the offer off.

handoff_on_compact.title: Handoff: on compaction
handoff_on_compact.description: core: Claude Code compacts as usual. handoff: manual and auto compaction write a handoff and the transcript becomes that handoff; on any failure Claude Code compacts as usual.

handoff_prompt_file.title: Handoff: prompt file
handoff_prompt_file.description: Path to the handoff prompt (~ allowed). Empty: the prompt bundled at hooks/handoff/prompts/handoff.md. Placeholder: {{cwd}}.

handoff_dir.title: Handoff: save folder
handoff_dir.description: Where handoffs and handoff.log are saved (~ allowed). Empty: ~/.claude/handoffs.
